description:
Otaku 'Norman', who writes reckless hateful posts on the internet as usual, then discovers an anonymous gay user who seems a bit mentally disturbed. The two of them, while having a keyboard battle, eventually end up meeting in person. But it turns out the gay user was 'Chris,' a popular person from the same department. To make matters worse, Chris, having learned Norman's secret, starts blackmailing him...

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/martini), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/martini_)

**Official Translations:**  
Japanese: [Beltoon](https://www.beltoon.jp/detail/martini), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.jp/ja/comic/martini)
